Hi! 🪸 I'm *Coral* from *Diving Planet* — we dive year-round in the Rosario Islands, departing from Cartagena or right from the islands. So happy to have you here! I'd love to help you put your plan together. 🌊

That sounds like a great plan! Since you’ve completed the theory and pool sessions, the *2-day Open Water Referral Course* is the right option. You’ll need to stay overnight on the islands; accommodation isn’t included.

The mini course is for already-certified divers, so it isn’t part of the Open Water certification.

The referral course requires a PADI referral form signed by your original instructor; it is the “Open Water Referral Course,” not a regular dive trip.

For two people, select two participants for each activity in the booking process.

msg: Ok. Thanks. We will work out the best days. Do you recommend any hotels on the island convenient for the diving?

Yes! For the most convenient access to diving, I’d recommend *Hotel San Pedro de Majagua* or *Hotel Cocoliso* on Isla Grande—our dive base is at both, and pick-up is direct.

Other nearby options with maritime access include *Rosario de Mar, Secreto, Ubuntu, Mulata, Eco Hotel Las Palmeras, and Pao Pao*. Accommodation isn’t included in the dive plans, so you’ll book directly with the hotel.

If you’re staying on the islands, pick-up and return are at your hotel if it has maritime access.

Where would you be departing from? This plan takes 2 days and you need to *stay on the islands* (accommodation is not included): you can leave *from Cartagena* on the first day or, if you're already *on the islands*, we arrange pickup at your hotel.

The refresher is booked as a *Dive Mini Course*. Since you’ll be staying on the islands, it’s *$134 USD per person online* (the $50 price doesn’t match our current rate). Book it here: https://book.divingplanet.org/book/dive-mini-course-already-on-island/20?language=en

Choose the refresher date and number of participants in the booking calendar, then pay online. The refresher is a one-day review with pool practice and one ocean dive; please complete the required medical form: https://form.jotform.com/divingplanetcartagena/exoneracion-curso-en-espanol

A refresher and a certified diver can join the same outing.

One important note: the refresher is for certified divers who haven’t dived in more than two years. For your *Open Water Referral Course*, use its separate booking link and select the two course days. Would you like me to share that link too?
